positions.title: Student Software Engineer
positions.description: I am a student at St. Louis community college studying Software Engineering.

positions.title: Application Support Specialist
positions.description:
Express Scripts provides integrated pharmacy benefit management services including network-pharmacy claims processing; home delivery pharmacy services; specialty pharmacy benefit management, through its subsidiary Accredo; benefit-design consultation; drug-utilization review; formulary management; and medical and drug data analysis services to manage drug plans for health plans, self-insured employers and government agencies (both as administrator of employee benefits and public assistance programs). One of its largest clients is the United States Department of Defense’s Tricare program. 

Responsibilities:
•	Scanned file for PHI(Personal health information)
•	Used proprietary dashboard application to monitor file scanning process
•	Traversed server log files for exceptions
•	Attended meetings and presented findings
•	Started/restarted batch processes
•	Updated excel spreadsheets
•	Functional testing of Services with SOAPUI
•	Test case design with SOAPUI 
•	Test case debugging in SOAPUI
•	Analyzed and examined returned XML from service via SOAPUI
•	Taken a formal course in which SOUPUI was used

positions.title: Computer Scientist
positions.description: Studying,Researching and Learning - Hibernate Object Relational Mapping Framework, the Spring FrameWork(AOP, MVC,Dependency Injection,Transactions, Data Access), the Java Collections Framework, web service development(SOA), and software design patterns. I have also been in review of all of the material as required by the Sun Certified Java Programmer and Sun Certified Web Component Developer, SCJD, and SCJP certifications. I have attended St. Louis community College  for 4 semesters.

positions.title: java developer
positions.description:
The United States Department of Agriculture provides leadership on food, agriculture, natural resources, rural development, nutrition, and related issues based on public policy, the best available science, and effective management. The Farm Loan Management Application is used to determine loan eligibility for agriculturalists. The application is constructed of J2EE,Struts,and Big Web Services.  

 Responsibilities:
•	Installed and tested j2ee web application profiler
•	Used Eclipse as development environment
•	Implemented white box tests for STRUTS value objects  
•	Corresponded with other team members to resolve incidents
•	Corresponded with remote teams via teleconferencing 
•	Corresponded with profiler application  developers via email and telephone to resolve 
          configurations/functionality
•	Traced code implemented in Core Java.
•	Reported to daily and weekly developer meetings and presented progress reports.

positions.title: Java Developer/Application Support
positions.description:
Automobile Industry
Client: VolksWagon, Auburn Hills, Mich
Role: Java Developer/Application Support Specialist
  
VolksWagon produces and provides various cars, trucks, and utility vehicles to both the commercial and non–commercial markets.The ElsaWeb application was developed in order to provide VolksWagon dealerships with a central location of support for warranty information, vehicle schematics, vehicle service records, and any information a dealer needed to service a VolksWagon customer. The application is constructed of J2EE ,Spring,Struts,Big Web Services,Pearl and batch processing scripts.  

Responsibilities:
•	Trace and debug J2EE application code.
•	Used and executed java programs. 
•	Used IBM RAD as development environment.
•	Traversed Websphere server logs.
•	Used Service Manager 9 to track incidents.  
•	Corresponded with other support teams to resolve incidents
•	Used ANT as build tool for J2EE projects
•	Corresponded with offshore teams via teleconferencing 
•	Corresponded with application users via email  and telephone to resolve incidents
•	Used Unix shell Scripts

Environment:  Java, Java EE, RAD, Unix, Spring, Struts, IBM Websphere AS, Windows 7, Lotus Notes.

positions.title: Java Developer
positions.description:
Telecommunications Industry
Client: Blackberry, Bellevue, WA                              	                                     
Role: Java Developer
  
Blackberry produces and provides various handheld smart phones for both the commercial and non–commercial markets. This application provides a point of central control and administration of a number of Blackberry and various other commercial brand smart phones. Accounts are sold to commercial businesses and used to add policies to groups of phones distributed to employees and so forth.

Responsibilities:
•	Involved in various SDLC phases like Development and Testing.
•	Used Spring framework to develop the MVC architecture. 
•	Debugged JSP's implemented in Javascript, JQuery, JSTL,and HTML using Fiddler ,FireBug, and 
        Google Web Tools.
•	Implemented tests in JMock and used Log4j for logging.
•	Involved in coding and maintaining Servlets and JSP components.  
•	Debugged and modified JQuery and JavaScript code to enhance performance and user 
        friendliness
•	Wrote and debugged SQL queries that performed database operations.
•	Used GIT Repository and GIT Merge Tool.
•	Used Maven to build the J2EE application.
•	Used Spring STS IDE for developing code modules in the development environment. 

Environment:  Java 6, J2EE 5, Hibernate  3.0, Spring 3, XML, Web Service JAX-RS, Spring MVC,SQLServer, Oracle 10g, HTML,XML,JQuery,DOJO,Javascript,JSON, XSLT, MS SQLServer,  Maven, Windows 8, JUnit 4, log 4j.

positions.title: Java Developer
positions.description:
Insurance Industry                        		       	                            	
Client: State Farm, Bloomington                              	                                     
Role: Java Developer
  
State Farm Insurance provides various forms of insurance for individuals and businesses such as auto, life, motorcycle, and medical insurance to name a few. Applicants may acquire quotes, purchase all types of insurance, and acquire information via an online web application. The applicant information is maintained in a database along with the details of the type of insurance purchased. This data is also accessed and used by agents, maintained for court cases, and used to generate statistics.

Responsibilities:
•	Involved in various SDLC phases like Design and Development.
•	Used Spring Webflow framework to develop the MVC architecture 
•	Developed the Business Logic using Plain Old Java Objects (POJOs). 
•	Designed Exception handling hierarchy. 
•	Used Core Java Exception Handling mechanism and classes.
•	Involved in the exchange and communication of design data with offshore development groups.  
•	Produced formal design documents such as process descriptions.
•	Acquired education on various proprietary frameworks.
•	Assisted in the design and implementation of code to integrate language internationalization 
        software.
•	Aided in the implementation of DAO pattern for Rest Web Services to check the laws and 
        standards of states.
•	Used Maven to build the J2EE application.
•	Used Spring STS IDE for developing code modules in the development environment. 

Environment:  Java 6, J2EE 5, Spring 3 , Hibernate  3.0, XML, Web Service JAX-RS(Rest), Mule ESB, PostgreSQL, HTML, XSLT, Spring STS,  Maven, Windows XP, JUnit 4, log 4j, and various State Farm proprietary frameworks.

positions.title: Java developer
positions.description:
Anju Sharma                                                                                                                  
Banking Industry                        		    	                              	
Grand Bank of Texas, Dallas                              	                                     
Role: Java Developer
  
Grand Bank of Texas provides funds or loans to people with small business requirements. Applicants get their loans sanctioned based on their credit history. The applicant information is maintained in a database along with the details of the loan for repayment. This data is filtered into different categories based on parameters like type of account, loan amount, due date. The filtered data is used for statistics for generating reports.

Responsibilities:
•	Involved in various SDLC phases like Design, Development and Testing.
•	Used Struts framework to develop the MVC architecture and modularize the application.
•	Developed the Business Logic using Plain Old Java Objects (POJOs). 
•	Developed Graphical User Interfaces using HTML and JSP's for user interaction.
•	Used various Core Java concepts such as Exception Handling, Collection APIs to implement 
        various features and enhancements.
•	Involved in coding, maintaining, and administering Servlets and JSP components to be deployed 
        on Apache Tomcat and WebLogic Application servers.  
•	Wrote and debugged PL/SQL queries, stored procedures, and triggers to perform back-end 
        database operations.
•	Implemented Hibernate in the data access object layer to access and update information in the 
        Oracle10g Database.
•	Implemented the logging mechanism using log4j framework
•	Wrote test cases in JUnit for unit testing of classes.


Environment:  Java 6, J2EE 5, Struts 1.3.2 , Hibernate  3.0, Spring 2.5, Swing, XML, Web Service JAX WS 2.1, Apache Axis 2.1, Oracle 10g, HTML,XML, XSLT, Eclipse 3.5,  Apache Ant 1.7.1, Windows XP, JUnit 4.3, log 4j 1.2.15.

positions.title: Java Developer
positions.description:
Anju Sharma                                                                                                                         10/08 – 3/09
Lockheed Martin/DOD Air-Force, Dayton, Ohio 					
Role: J2EE developer 
Worked with Java Server Page, Spring, and Hibernate technology stack.  This application was an inventory management application that tracks inventory movement and procurement operations across divisions.  Utilized JUnit test cases to test Spring services and DAO implementation layers.  Code control was performed using subversion and continuous integration was done using cruise control. Help design Axis 2 web services that delivered both restricted and non-restricted data to DOD clients. Hibernate was used to aid in managing data in the DAO layer to serve primarily Adobe Flex clients and web service consumers.

Responsibilities:
•	Involved in analysis and design phases of Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC).
•	Used Agile SCRUM methodology for focusing in end user requirements.
•	Developed UML use-case, class, object, sequence, collaboration, and activity diagrams.
•	Used Spring framework to develop the MVC architecture and modularize the application.
•	Developed user interfaces using JSP and HTML for views and to interact with the end users.
•	Developed interactive modules using JSP and Servlets. 
•	Aided in the design of Stateful Session Beans for maintaining user sessions.
•	Created set of classes using DAO pattern with generic database related methods to achieve 
        functionalities such as create, update, delete and select to make the database operations 
        reusable.
•	Used JUnit testing tool to perform unit testing on individual classes.
•	Implemented a search mechanism using Stored Procedures, Sequences in Oracle PL/SQ 

Environment:Java 5, Servlets, JSP, EJB 2.0, Spring MVC, Oracle 10g, HTML, XML, XSLT, JSTL, EL, Apache Ant 1.7, Windows XP, JUnit, log 4j,Java Swing.

positions.title: Java developer
positions.description:
VanHoose Associates provides business process management, document management, enterprise content management,workflow/collaboration, and government compliant records management software to the United States Military Organizations and others.

Responsibilities:
•	Involved in various SDLC phases like Design, Development and Testing.
•	Debugged the Business Logic implemented with Plain Old Java Objects (POJOs). 
•	Worked with various Core Java concepts such as Exception Handling, Collection APIs to 
         implement various features and enhancements.
•	Modified and debugged HTML.
•	Involved in coding and maintaining Servlets and JSP components to be deployed on IBM 
        Websphere Application servers.  
•	Wrote and debugged PL/SQL queries to perform back-end database operations.
•	Used Perforce version control system.
•	Worked with the log4j framework
•	Used Ant to build the J2EE application.
•	Used Oracle JDeveloper and SQLDeveloper IDEs for developing code modules in the          
         development environment. 
•	Performed software acceptance testing

Environment:  Java 5, J2EE 5, Struts 1.2 ,XML,Oracle 10g, HTML,XML, Eclipse 2.0,  Apache Ant 1.5, Windows XP, JUnit 3.0, log 4j 1.0,Oracle SQLDeveloper, OracleJDeveloper, IBM Wbsphere
